name: Rewind Regiment
description: Toy soldiers fight by themselves on a play tray. Lose, drag the timeline back to where it went wrong, change one thing, and watch the battle play out anew. Seventeen levels in six rooms: grunts, riflemen, bazookas, tin tanks, jeeps, helicopters and wind-up robots, with marbles, dominoes, trains, jack-in-the-boxes, block towers, catapults and spinning tops.
